yaml:
# Generated by parstack set-up-work-triggers. Edit the run command, not the guard.
name: agent-run

on:
  issues:
    types: [labeled]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 6 * * 1"

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.issue.number || 'scheduled' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  run:
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'issues' && github.event.label.name == 'agent-run') ||
      (github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && (github.event.comment.body == '/run' || startsWith(github.event.comment.body, '/run ')) && contains(fromJSON('["OWNER", "MEMBER", "COLLABORATOR"]'), github.event.comment.author_association)) ||
      github.event_name == 'schedule'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Guard against double start
        id: guard
        if: github.event_name != 'schedule'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          NUMBER: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
          RUNNING_LABEL: "running"
        run: |
          labels="$(gh api "repos/$REPO/issues/$NUMBER/labels" --jq '.[].name')"
          if printf '%s\n' "$labels" | grep -Fxq "$RUNNING_LABEL"; then
            echo "Already running on #$NUMBER; skipping."
            echo "acquired=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi
          gh api -X POST "repos/$REPO/issues/$NUMBER/labels" -f "labels[]=$RUNNING_LABEL" > /dev/null
          echo "acquired=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Run
        if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || steps.guard.outputs.acquired == 'true'
        env:
          RUN_COMMAND: "make agent-run"
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
          ISSUE_TITLE: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}
          COMMENT_BODY: ${{ github.event.comment.body }}
        run: bash -c "$RUN_COMMAND"

      - name: Release running label
        if: always() && steps.guard.outputs.acquired == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          NUMBER: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
          RUNNING_LABEL: "running"
        run: gh api -X DELETE "repos/$REPO/issues/$NUMBER/labels/$RUNNING_LABEL" > /dev/null
